## Frame-rate data of update 1.4.1 from docs/RESEARCH.md (seedds/nxnative), checked on our ELF (hwaoc-fps, docs/FRAMESTEP.md).

column4: KTGL device config built at start-up ({1920, 1080, 3, 9, 5, interval 2, ...})
KIDS frame task: where its two fps paths join (nxnative's patch site; not hooked here)
KIDS frame task: ldr w8,[x23,#0x34], the frame-rate object's step (nxnative's patch site; not hooked here)
frame-rate block {fps, interval (60 Hz vsyncs per update), fps, float fps} = {30, 2, 30, 30.0}
KTGL device pointer (+0x32d0: the device frame rate, 59.94 / interval)
KIDS frame task (once per update, before the scene): Info::frame_update, the base's frame boundary
KIDS frame task: udiv x26,x24,x20 (period = tick frequency / fps): x20 = huge, the game's own 1/fps wait does not hold
KIDS frame task, after the wait (every path): per-update ticks, the frame-rate block and the device frame rate
KIDS frame task: w8 / s0 = the frame-rate object's two steps (x23 = the object, +0x48 its fps), [x19,#0x18] stored
KIDS frame task, no frame-rate object: s0 / w8 = 1 / fps or the measured time, [x19,#0x18] stored
scene update: after add w10,w10,#1 (an event cutscene's frame, 30 fps frames)
scene update: after sub w10,w10,#1 (the event cutscene's frames left)
after ucvtf s1,s1 of the block's fps (+8): s1 = 1 / step

column1: ## The block's interval read as a float multiplier: ldr s/w <- interval; ucvtf s<reg>; the site is the instruction after the ucvtf (s<reg> = 60 Hz ticks of this update, fractional).
